items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Sleepy Tomlin as a 'good buddy' and asks the interviewee to compare his style, but the interviewee (Joe Thomas) does not respond with any personal anecdote, confirmation of meeting, or description of a relationship.

ctx.x: It was a trumpet town. It was very much a trumpet town.
Was that other guy Sleepy Tomlin or something?
Sleepy, yeah, a good buddy. Beautiful trumpet player.
